title: Faster DGX Spark and expanded model management
summary: CloudlessOS 0.2.1 makes the DGX Spark interface inference-friendly and adds a complete Hugging Face model workflow across supported systems.
changes: Keep the DGX Spark interface at near-zero idle GPU usage by disabling animations by default, while offering an explicit per-display opt-in with a shared-GPU performance warning.
Suspend optional interface motion during active inference so model throughput and concurrent request handling remain the priority.
Use Qwen3.6-35B-A3B as the validated DGX Spark default model with Spark-specific vLLM and SGLang reasoning, tool-calling, and unified-memory settings.
Search Hugging Face from Model Manager, authenticate for gated or private repositories, inspect compatibility, download models, and track their installed files and progress inside CloudlessOS.
Manage display resolution and UI scaling from Settings, with Spark-aware hardware, storage, and DGX Dashboard presentation.
Improve the welcome tour at high resolutions with lower rendering cost, reliable click-through targets, and a clear blurred spotlight.
Make ComfyUI optional instead of preinstalled and improve model download visibility throughout the interface.
Preserve NVIDIA repository key access during DGX Spark installation so APT signature verification remains reliable.
